why: the fresh sweep retained 232 ATTRIBUTED rows and I had only examined the 10 unattributed. If families the audit itself calls unevidenced are absorbing fresh rows, the unattributed count understates what is actually unexplained.
what_candidate_not_finding_means: the audit's own entry for I2_matcher_accounting reads: 'no decisive signature: net-identical 0/403, tolerance-passing 7/403, count-mismatch 3/403. Profile recorded for the next pass; resolving it needs the reject reason, which these signatures do not measure.' It is a holding label, not an explanation -- the family names a shape whose mechanism was investigated and not established.
the_finding: 10 rows are UNATTRIBUTED and another 86 are attributed to families with no established mechanism. On fresh data 96 of 242 divergences -- 39.7% -- lack a real explanation, against the 4.1% the certification gate counts. The gate measures whether a row reached a registered family, and the audit measures whether that family explains anything. Those are different questions and this session has been reporting the first as though it answered the second.
this_is_the_risk_the_audit_was_created_t: its purpose statement says the family table 'does not record WHY a family diverges, and that gap is what let limit:roll_divergent_lethality sit under the comment a limit of the comparison, not an engine fault while C27 moved 285 rows out of it'. The audit found the gap and bucketed it honestly; what nobody then did was carry the bucket back into how the residue is reported.
the_blocker_the_audit_named_has_since_be: I2's entry says resolution 'needs the reject reason, which these signatures do not measure'. C59 and C60 measured exactly that -- the matcher's own rejection reason per row, and the per-row exit census inside roll_component_events_agree. The candidate-not-finding families can now be re-derived against evidence that did not exist when they were bucketed.
what_this_does_to_the_projection: ~125 unattributed at 10,000 games stands as a projection of the GATE. The projection of what is genuinely unexplained is roughly ten times that. Both numbers are real and they answer different questions; only the first is what the contract counts.
does_not_reach_a_pass: unchanged; this widens what a PASS would have to mean, it does not move the gate
